posts.title: What The Cure Trap Missed
posts.description: A traditionally published book is finished the day it goes to press. This one isn't. Readers have been finding the gaps, and this post is the result: a plain-language changelog of what was missed, what was wrong, and what the next edition of The Cure Trap will add.

posts.title: Announcing The Cure Trap: Why the Most Funded Word in Medicine Keeps Failing Patients
posts.description: Billions raised. Zero cures. Why does the most funded word in medicine keep failing patients? Read and download Benjamin Stecher’s new book, The Cure Trap—an uncensored ten-year investigation into the Parkinson’s research machine and a concrete blueprint for reform. Available now as a free PDF, EPUB, and AI audiobook.

posts.title: My Address to the Federal Parkinson’s Advisory Council
posts.description: Across five scientific sessions and 38 presenter and panelist slots at the federal Advisory Council on Parkinson’s Research, Care, and Services (ACPRCS), I was the only invited panelist actually living with diagnosed Parkinson’s disease—and I was given a single scripted question in the final slot before lunch.
